title: Extend the QQ16 odd-denominator obstruction to Clifford coefficients
body:
## Summary

```diff
 PR2546's fixed QQ16 complete-input obstruction
- Gaussian-dyadic coefficients; normalized Clifford coefficients excluded
+ Z[zeta_8,1/2] coefficients, including normalized Clifford gates and T
```

An odd-prime quotient `F_p[t]/(t^4+1)` is nonzero, so finite exact linear processing still preserves the proper ideal `pA`. This proves that an integer minor is invertible over the enlarged ring exactly when its determinant is a signed power of two. The credited QQ16 witness still has every allowed observation divisible by 5 and a required original coordinate equal to 1.

Adds only `research/qq16-clifford-denominator/`: a written proof, independently implemented source-bound checker, complete receipt, failure controls and registered replay. This resolves PR2546's explicit coefficient-ring exclusion; it does not repeat its minor census. The original PR2443 unread basis remains a positive control.

Scientific base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Task `joint-query-controller`, explicitly changed to this scalar-admission side result after checking live overlap. Exact sources, scope, open next question and freshness are in TASK.json/SOURCES.json. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2074#discussioncomment-18953096).

Credit Nick Petalas/PR2546 (`3aff4ccbfaa1005e5093e95535e4d99aa3813e54`) for the witness; starship-s/PR2443 for the two-cut decoder; Gareth Davidson/PR2432 for the unread-column criterion; thakrarsagar/PR2470 for separate retention work; Ali Romman and the retained QQ16/native/compiler lineage. No predecessor executable is imported or copied.

## Evidence

- **Before:** `1/sqrt(2)` was outside the proved Gaussian-dyadic coefficient ring.
  **After:** the written quotient argument covers every finite tensor depth in `Z[zeta_8,1/2]`. The new checker reproduces both minor inverses and all 224 concrete observations from the retained packet, checks 578 exact product reductions, literal H/S/T/inverse fixtures and 14 tensor basis columns.
- Six semantic controls and six behavioral test groups pass, including optimized mathematical-defect rejection, source/receipt corruption and a Git-free read-only export.
- Registered normal/optimized CPython 3.12.15 replay, CPython 3.13.5 optimized replay, all 65 repository research-workflow tests, Ruff and diff checks pass on Linux x86_64 / WSL2.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-clifford-denominator
python3.12 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
ruff check research/qq16-clifford-denominator --select E,F,I,UP,B,SIM --line-length 100
```

Main and the predecessor head were reconfirmed unchanged. The submission overlap refresh completely paginated 812 open PRs and 1276 Discussion records, with no warnings; metadata search excludes arbitrary diffs. The new extension was not found in that search.

Limitations: exact, data-independent affine decoding under the fixed complete-input two-cut contract only. This does not exclude selected-input-only recovery, odd-denominator operations, new observations, nonlinear/adaptive decoding or approximation followed by rounding. No full native-alphabet audit, physical access/retention, hosting, recursive precision, all-size admission, selected cold replay, human/formal-kernel review, supplier or new kappa is claimed. Hosted CI is not a claimed pass.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One opt-in package only. Selected records, frozen sources and existing packages are unchanged. The exact-affine and fixed-observation restrictions must remain attached to the obstruction.
